svg.title: Key keeper: generation-bound own-key signing; retirement and identity revocation are separate

g.text: Key keeper: generation-bound own-key signing; retirement and identity revocation are separate
Integration stays disabled until registration/revocation API and
broker migration procedure are published and qualified.
validate active ledger and registration tuple:
(uid, generation, identity path, owner, registration generation)
derive registered identity path inside the secure boundary
sign canonical bytes with caller's own key; audit
Registration records the one-shot flag; detach before UID reuse.
Account retirement does not itself revoke an identity.
Only the registering dispatcher may revoke its recorded one-shot
identity, after confirmed retirement, as a separate journaled effect.
Unknown/refused revocation retains the cleanup obligation.
Standing identity revocation requires an operator-signed record.
pubkey(identity) remains a public read; no private key is returned.
Signing and decryption are audited and rate-limited.
Decryption uses the caller's own identity.
The agent-side caller signs its outbound exact bytes under its own UID.
No bridge on-behalf signing operation is adopted.
